items: AI is already running core services across Southeast Asia, from banking and retail to logistics and government, so businesses there need a plan for its effects on jobs and compliance.
Entry-level, rules-based roles such as call center work face the most automation, while demand grows for people who combine technology and operations skills, so invest in retraining your team now.
Regulation in the region is mostly voluntary today, but frameworks like Singapore's AI Verify may become mandatory, so put your AI governance playbook in place early.
AI that works in Southeast Asia has to handle local languages, mixed-language conversations, low bandwidth and cultural nuance, and products that ignore this are likely to fail.
